_comment: CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX -- security response headers for the static site
_why: The static site is served by GitHub Pages behind Cloudflare. GitHub Pages ignores _headers, so the live pages carry only HSTS: no X-Frame-Options / CSP frame-ancestors (clickjacking), X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy or Permissions-Policy. /api/* already gets these from the Worker (SECURITY_HEADERS in workers/intel-gateway/src/index.js) and is excluded here. /swarm/* (sentinel-apex-swarm-live) is excluded too (2026-09-28): that Worker sends a stricter CSP (default-src 'none') and X-Frame-Options DENY, and this rule's 'set' would otherwise replace them with weaker values. Every Worker route prefix on intel.cyberdudebivash.com must be excluded; tests/test_clickjacking_guard.py derives the list from workers/*/wrangler.toml. P0 R36 adds exact Worker routes /feed.json and /latest.json; exclude these too, preserving their stronger Worker response headers.
_apply: Run the 'Apply static-site security headers' workflow (.github/workflows/apply-security-headers.yml): mode=plan shows the change, mode=apply backs up the existing http_response_headers_transform entrypoint, upserts only this rule (matched by description prefix), preserves every other rule and its order, and verifies live headers. Needs CF_API_TOKEN with Zone Transform Rules Edit. Manual dashboard alternative: Rules -> Transform Rules -> Modify Response Header -> create this one rule.
_csp_note: Only frame-ancestors is set in the header CSP. Browsers enforce every CSP they receive, so a header policy containing only frame-ancestors restricts nothing else, and the pages' existing <meta> CSPs keep governing scripts/styles/connect.

rules.description: Security headers on static pages (excludes all Worker-served paths, including /feed.json and /latest.json)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "intel.cyberdudebivash.com") and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/api" "/reports" "/taxii" "/auth" "/swarm" "/feed.json" "/latest.json"}) and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/reports/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/taxii/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/auth/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/swarm/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/feed.json/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/latest.json/")

Permissions-Policy.value: geolocation=(), camera=(), microphone=(), usb=(), accelerometer=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=()
